note: Hypothesis: TFIDF_PARAMS.max_features was 2000, tuned back when train had ~175 rows; now train has 1382 rows, likely enough to support a richer vocabulary. Tried max_features=5000. Result: HGB log_mse 1.6197 -> 1.6086 (log_r2 0.567 -> 0.570), a modest win - margin is small enough it could partly be noise at n_val=292, but it's a genuine improvement on the north-star metric so promoted per program.md's rule. mdape got slightly worse (65.3% -> 68.7%), a reminder log_mse and mdape don't always move together. Ridge got worse with the larger vocabulary (more overfitting risk on a linear model) but wasn't the winning candidate either way.
